Environmental Traps
===================

### Ice Cart Trap

[![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/0/0f/Ice_Cart_Trap.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Ice_Cart_Trap.png)

[](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Ice_Cart_Trap.png "Enlarge")

**Ice Cart Trap**

The Ice Cart Trap in **The Gates of Dragonfall** is on the left center of the [map](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Maps "Maps")
 from the player spawn.  
This [environmental trap](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Environmental_Trap "Environmental Trap")
 deals 0 damage towards [enemies](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies")
 when activated but will freeze them in return.  

*   The Ice Cart can freeze [enemies](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies")
     even with the [Headstrong mutator](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mutators "Mutators")
    .
*   30 second cooldown timer once activated before it can be used again.
*   Will not be reflected off shields such as [Geode's](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Geodes "Geodes")
     shield.

  

### Fire Cart Trap

[![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8f/Fire_Cart_Trap.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Fire_Cart_Trap.png)

[](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Fire_Cart_Trap.png "Enlarge")

**Fire Cart Trap**

The Fire Cart Trap in **The Gates of Dragonfall** is on the right center of the [map](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Maps "Maps")
 from the player spawn.  
This [environmental trap](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Environmental_Trap "Environmental Trap")
 deals magical [fire](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Fire "Fire")
 damage towards [enemies](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies")
 when activated.  

*   The Fire Cart deals a flat 25,000 damage when fired at an [enemy](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies")
    .  
    

This damage is affected by resistances and does not increment off higher or lower difficulty.

*   30 second cooldown timer once activated before it can be used again.
*   Will not be reflected off shields such as [Geode's](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Geodes "Geodes")
     shield.
